input.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `input`, example: `input.h5mu`

counts_layer.description: Name of the counts layer, if not specified, X is used.

layer_spliced.description:
Name of the layer to store the spliced abundances in. Will be used as key in the .layer attribute of the
output MuData object.

layer_unspliced.description:
Name of the layer to store the unspliced abundances in.
Will be used as key in the .layer attribute of the output MuData object.

layer_ambiguous.description:
Name of the layer to store the abundances in for which no fate was determined.
Will be used as key in the .layer attribute of the output MuData object.

output.description: Output directory. If it does not exist, will be created.
output.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `path/to/output`

output_h5mu.help_text: type: `string`, multiple: False, required, direction: `output`, example: `output.h5mu`

output_compression.description:
Compression format to use for the output AnnData and/or Mudata H5 files.
By default no compression is applied.

filtering and normalization.title: Filtering and normalization
filtering and normalization.description: Arguments for filtering, normalization an log transform (see scvelo.pp.filter_and_normalize function)

min_counts.description: Minimum number of counts required for a gene to pass filtering (spliced).

min_counts_u.description: Minimum number of counts required for a gene to pass filtering (unspliced).

min_cells.description: Minimum number of cells expressed required to pass filtering (spliced).

min_cells_u.description: Minimum number of cells expressed required to pass filtering (unspliced).

min_shared_counts.description: Minimum number of counts (both unspliced and spliced) required for a gene.

min_shared_cells.description: Minimum number of cells required to be expressed (both unspliced and spliced).

n_principal_components.description: Number of principal components to use for calculating moments.

n_neighbors.description:
Number of neighbors to use. First/second-order moments are computed for each
cell across its nearest neighbors, where the neighbor graph is obtained from
euclidean distances in PCA space.

nextflow input-output arguments.title: Nextflow input-output arguments
nextflow input-output arguments.description: Input/output parameters for Nextflow itself. Please note that both publishDir and publish_dir are supported but at least one has to be configured.
